newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE euroyen end sharply lower in line with JGBs.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE euroyen end sharply lower in line with JGBs.

text.p: The key December three-month euroyen futures contract ended sharply lower on Friday due to a steep fall in Japanese government bonds, traders said.
JGBs plunged on Friday as Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co's business suspension, the first such case among insurers in the postwar period, triggered fears of higher interest rates.
Japan's low interest rate policy has been blamed for low returns on financial institutions' investments.
